pro_course_detail.title: Interview Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Prior to becoming a university professor, I worked in the business world. I was previously a recruiter for finance and accounting professionals and have also worked in marketing.  Through iTalki, I have worked with many global business professionals and academics to prepare for upcoming job interviews.

In our meetings, we will practice delivering effective and concise responses to various types of interview questions that go beyond technical questions related to your work (depending on your needs).  Although we can practice questions directly related to your line of work, we will most likely focus on mastering responses to questions including the following structures:
1) Tell me about yourself.
2) Tell me about a time when you. . . (describing past accomplishments and work experiences)
3) Two-part questions, e.g., Describe your leadership style, and tell me about a time where you successfully handled a conflict among your team members. 
4) Hypothetical questions, e.g., What would you do if you had an upcoming deadline that you most likely were not going to meet? 

Additionally, you can expect to receive feedback on the following: grammar, pronunciation, word choice, fluency, eye contact, body language, facial expressions, level of confidence, etc.

During our sessions, we will have a mock interview where I will assume the role of the hiring manager, and you will be the job candidate.  During the practice interview, I will take comprehensive notes on your performance. You will be provided the notes at the end of our session, and I can also give a video link to a recording of the practice interview (optional).

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS SPEAKING** BOOST YOUR BAND SCORE**PROVEN SUCCESS RECORD**
pro_course_detail.description:
As an experienced IELTS coach, I’m here to help you achieve a speaking score above 7 and unlock your full potential. This comprehensive lesson is tailored to equip you with the skills and confidence needed to excel in the IELTS Speaking module.

What You Can Expect:
The IELTS Speaking module consists of three key parts, each designed to assess your communication skills:

Part 1: Interview (4-5 minutes)
Engage in a friendly conversation with straightforward questions about yourself. This is your opportunity to make a strong first impression!

Part 2: Individual Long Turn (3-4 minutes)
You’ll be given a topic to discuss. With one minute to prepare, you’ll present a coherent and structured talk for 1-2 minutes. Let’s make sure your ideas flow seamlessly!

Part 3: Discussion (4-5 minutes)
This section involves a deeper exploration of the themes introduced in Part 2. You'll discuss broader questions, showcasing your ability to articulate complex ideas and opinions.

Assessment Criteria
Your performance will be evaluated based on:

Fluency and Coherence: The ability to expand on answers and connect your thoughts logically.
Lexical Resource: A diverse range of vocabulary and effective use of collocations.
Grammatical Range and Accuracy: The correct use of various grammatical structures.
Pronunciation: Clear articulation and natural intonation.
My Coaching Approach
Feeling nervous about the exam? Don’t worry! Together, we’ll tackle any anxiety and build your confidence through:

Mock Sessions for Parts 1, 2, and 3: Practice each section of the test in a realistic, timed setting to strengthen your speaking skills and familiarity with the format.
Tailored Practice: We’ll work on common interview questions and develop comprehensive answers.
Vocabulary Enhancement: Learn key phrases and synonyms relevant to the exam topics to elevate your language use.
Pronunciation Drills: Focus on clarity and intonation to ensure you communicate effectively.
Ready to Succeed?
